postureExplain.calm: The market is relatively stable. A good time to study, not to react to every tick.
postureExplain.unsettled: Tension present: strong moves or skewed funding. Read the summary before concluding.
postureExplain.storm: Elevated stress. Cut noise, avoid FOMO, confirm causes in the analyses.
postureExplain.weird: Signals disagree. Don't trust a single metric — demand context.

etf.title: Spot ETFs
etf.subtitle: Daily net flows for US spot ETFs — proxy for institutional spot demand.
etf.whyBody: When a spot ETF creates shares, the issuer buys the asset in the spot market. Redemptions sell it. Daily net flow (US) helps confirm real spot bid beyond perps/leverage.
etf.unit: Values in USD millions (US), Farside convention.
etf.solUnavailable: SOL flows unavailable or Farside table not parseable right now.
